instruction.text: Find Liverpool on the map to learn about the development of rock music in the 1960s.

feedback.end: Liverpool was the birthplace of a new musical genre in Britain called pop rock. This was mainly thanks to a band called The Beatles.

instruction.text: The Beatles performed regularly at The Cavern Club in Liverpool. Drag the band members to the stage.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>audience applause big crowd</voice>

feedback.finish: The Beatles became extremely popular in the UK and the USA for their songwriting talent and unique pop rock sound. Their songs had heavy guitar, bass and drum sounds.

instruction.text: Select the crowd to speak to a Beatles fan at a big concert.

atoms.b: When did you first ((++listen throw)) to The Beatles?
I heard them on the ((++radio toaster)) at home, and then my friend gave me one of their records.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+2st'>I heard them on the radio at home, and then my friend gave me one of their records.</prosody>

atoms.b: What is your favourite ((++song painting)) of theirs?
I would say that it has to be Yellow Submarine. It’s got such a catchy ((++chorus walrus))!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+2st'>I would say that it has to be Yellow Submarine. It’s got such a catchy chorus!</prosody>

atoms.b: Why do you think the Beatles are so ((++popular scary))?

This “Beatlemania” is definitely led by young people. The Beatles’ pop ((++rock jazz)) sound allows us to express ourselves and rebel against the old-fashioned music that our ((++parents pets)) listen to.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+2st'>This Beetle mania is definitely led by young people. The Beatles’ pop rock sound allows us to express ourselves and rubell against the old-fashioned music that our parents listen to.</prosody>

instruction.text: Select the new ways that people listened to music in the sixties as a result of The Beatles.

feedback.correct1: The Beatles were one of the first bands to perform in big arenas and sports stadiums. They sold record-breaking numbers of tickets.
feedback.correct2: The Beatles made short video clips that were played on television to promote their new songs. This was before the rise of proper music videos in the eighties.

instruction.text: Which types of music do you think The Beatles influenced?

feedback.finish: Their songwriting talent and transformation of rock music went on to inspire other artists across different styles in the years to come.
